propositions: Mypy's disallow_untyped_defs flag accepts `: Any` return/parameter annotations, failing to constrain explicit-Any usage across the codebase

37 untyped function definitions remain unresolved in 12 packages (rebar._snapshot, rebar._store, rebar.schemas, rebar.opcert_service, rebar.review_bot, rebar._io, rebar._engine_support, rebar.audit, rebar._cli and others), blocking promotion of those packages to the ratchet

A two-tier mypy ratchet is needed: tier 1 for disallow_untyped_defs (unannotated defs) and tier 2 for disallow_any_explicit (explicit-Any constraints), enforced via shrink-only test assertions in test_mypy_ratchet.py

After adding return-type and parameter annotations to 36 function definitions across 14 files with no new `: Any` introductions, 13 packages become tier-1 eligible and 2 packages (rebar._cli, rebar._snapshot) become tier-2 eligible
The reducer package was deferred due to match_predicate(value) requiring type union or Any to satisfy both the signature and call-site constraints without introducing new explicit-Any
Repo-wide explicit-Any count must remain unchanged and verified by baseline grep assertion to prevent regressing the typed contract quality
